_meta.description: CodeMap — node-to-code mapping for WC3 flowcharts

pending.description: Central hub for inventory quantity deltas. All quantity changes flow through Pending before updating Item.

functions.name: Item.quantity
functions.context: JSONField with on_hand, allocated, available, on_p, on_so, on_in, on_po, on_wo, on_r

item.description: Product with quantity JSON tracking all inventory buckets.

order.description: Sales order — customer commitment. Creates +on_so and -on_p pending records.

invoice.gl_impact: AR debit, Revenue credit, Tax credit, COGS debit, Inventory credit, Commission
invoice.description: Invoice — shipment event. Financial event triggers GL and inventory movement.

purchase.description: Purchase order to vendor. GAP: +on_po pending record is NOT created.

receipt.description: Receipt of purchased goods. Creates pending for +on_hand, -on_po.

workorder.description: Work order completion — production items enter inventory.

wo_complete.description: Work order completion event. Same service as workorder.

proposal.description: Sales proposal — forecast. on_p tracks weighted probability.

available.description: Computed available quantity: on_hand - allocated. Recomputed on save.

allocated.description: Reserved inventory — committed to sales orders. Subtracted from on_hand to get available.

on_r.description: Returns pending — goods expected back from customers.

on_hand.description: Physical inventory — what is in the warehouse.

on_so.description: Committed to sales orders — reduces available.

on_po.description: Expected from purchase orders — increases available.

on_wo.description: In production via work orders — increases available.

on_p.description: Forecast quantity from proposals — weighted by probability.

on_in.description: Invoiced — goods that have been shipped.

order_to_invoice.gl_impact: AR debit, Revenue credit, Tax credit, COGS debit, Inventory credit, Commission
order_to_invoice.description: Invoice creation from order. Financial event — triggers GL and inventory movement.

proposal_to_order.description: Order creation from proposal. Converts forecast to commitment.

receive_purchase.description: Purchase receipt — goods arrive, on_hand increases, on_po decreases.

complete_workorder.description: Work order completion — production items enter inventory.

adjust_inventory.description: Manual inventory adjustment — direct change to on_hand.

journalize_invoice.gl_impact: AR, Revenue, Tax, COGS, Inventory, Commission
journalize_invoice.description: General ledger posting for invoice — creates journal entries.

journalize_payment.gl_impact: Cash debit, AR credit (or AP debit, Cash credit)
journalize_payment.description: General ledger posting for payment — cash application.

journalize_purchase.description: General ledger posting for purchase orders.

flight_sim.description: Inventory flight simulator — interactive training for inventory flows.

contacts.description: Central identity — customers, vendors, employees, prospects.

proposals.description: Sales proposals — forecasts weighted by probability.

linkage.description: Shared line data — specs, related records, data at time of action.

inv_layer.description: Inventory costing layer — tracks on_hand by receipt cost.

prop_line.description: Proposal line — quantity.placed, actioned, remaining, canceled.

order_line.description: Order line — quantity.placed, actioned, remaining, canceled.

purchase_line.description: Purchase line — quantity.placed, actioned, remaining, canceled, received.

invoice_line.description: Invoice line — quantity.placed, actioned, remaining, canceled, parent.

action.description: Universal task — who, what, why, when, where, how. References any record. Tracks communication touches.

functions.name: Action.parent_action
functions.context: FK to self via uuid — parent-child hierarchy

parent_action.description: Parent action — opportunity or case. Child actions are touches (email, call, visit).

document.description: File storage — images, videos, PDFs. Inline-encoded in config or external path. EXIF extraction, virus scan.

functions.name: upload_view
functions.context: inline encoding: zlib+base64 for small files

upload.description: File upload pipeline — checksum, inline encode, EXIF extract, virus scan, create Document.

linkage_parent.description: LinkageEntry parent — clusters action with its attached documents via group_id.

linkage_child.description: LinkageEntry child — document attached to action. Same group_id as parent.

contact.description: Central identity — customers, vendors, employees. Has related Email, Phone, Address models.

functions.name: Action with action_type='email'
functions.context: action_type enum includes call, email, visit, meeting, demo, etc.

email_touch.description: Email touch — Action with action_type='email'. Subject in action field, body in description.

call_touch.description: Phone call touch — Action with action_type='call'. Notes in description, duration in config.

visit_touch.description: Visit touch — Action with action_type='visit'. Location in metadata.address, photos via LinkageEntry.

meeting_touch.description: Meeting touch — Action with action_type='meeting'. Attendees in assigned_to, agenda in description.

mail_merge.description: Mail merge — template-based email generation. merge, preview, send, bulk_send.

retro.description: Retrospection on Action — intent, grade A-F, TFTS arc, impact predicted vs actual. Alice auto-populates.

functions.name: Action.kanban_column
functions.context: choices: Backlog, Planning, InProcess, Review, Complete

kanban.description: Kanban view — Action workflow columns. Backlog → Planning → InProcess → Review → Complete.

touch_timeline.description: Touch timeline — all child actions for a parent, ordered by dt_created. Shows multi-touch sequence.

documents.description: Attached documents — proposals, photos, videos, meeting notes. Linked via LinkageEntry.

functions.name: detect
functions.context: auto-detect bank format from CSV headers

statement_sorter.description: Statement Sorter — free standalone tool. Drop bank CSVs, classify business vs personal, export. Lead gen for WebClerk. Feeds Payment.expense.

statement_classify.description: Classification step — user marks each line as business or personal, assigns category from 22 standard categories.

statement_export.description: Export — classified lines become Payment records in WebClerk. Business lines → expense, personal lines → excluded.

functions.name: Payment
functions.context: AR+AP via type field; signed amounts

payment.description: Payment — handles AR (received) and AP (expense). Signed amounts. Category maps to GL. Statement Sorter feeds expense side.

expense.description: Expense — Payment with type=expense. Category from Statement Sorter maps to GL account. Checkbook-style entry.
